introHtml: Set in sleeve workwear offers a tailored look with a clean shoulder seam, making it ideal for corporate uniforms or safety apparel. Unlike raglan or drop shoulder styles, the set-in sleeve provides a more structured fit that works well under jackets or for professional settings. Common decoration methods include embroidery on the chest or left sleeve, and screen printing on the back. Whether you need polo shirts for a trade show or button-downs for your team, this sleeve style ensures a polished appearance.
